metadata.services: Triple Play Bundle: Fiber 500 + Digital TV + Voice ($110/mo)

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is David. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi David. I'm calling about my bill. I need to... well, I need to discuss a payment issue.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly help you with that. To access your account, I'll need to verify your information. Could you please start with your full name?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, it's Kimberly Smith.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Ms. Smith. And do you have your Cymbal Telecom customer ID or the phone number associated with the account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I have the customer ID, one second... okay, it's CUST-1020.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Got it. CUST-1020. And for the final security verification, could you please provide the 4-digit PIN you set up for the account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, it's 1906.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you. I have your account pulled up now. I see you're on our Triple Play Bundle. How can I assist you with your payment today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, so... this is a little embarrassing. I had a major car repair that came out of nowhere and it's completely wiped me out for the month. I can't make the full payment that's due.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand, Ms. Smith. These things happen, and I appreciate you calling us to discuss it. Let's see what we can do to help.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you. I'm just really worried you're going to shut my services off. I work from home, so my internet is critical.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please don't worry. Your account is in good standing and you're not in any immediate danger of disconnection. We have options for situations just like this. Let me review the current balance.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, thank you. That's a relief.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, I see a past due balance from last month's cycle of $110, and the current bill which is also $110. There's also a $10 late fee that was applied. So the total amount due is $230.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right, $230. I just... I can't pay that all at once right now. Is there any way to split it up or get an extension?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, absolutely. We can set up a payment arrangement. This would allow you to pay off the past-due amount over the next few billing cycles.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, really? How would that work?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What we can do is take the total arrears and split it into smaller, more manageable payments that get added to your upcoming bills.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay... so what would my payments look like?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let's see. The total past due amount is $220. We could split that into two payments. And you know, since you called us proactively and have been a long-time customer, I can go ahead and waive that $10 late fee for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You can do that? That would be amazing, thank you so much.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome. So, let me just remove that fee... okay, it's done. Now the past due balance is $220.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, $220. So you can split that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. The most common arrangement is to split it over two months. That would mean we add $110 to your next bill, and another $110 to the bill after that.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So, my next bill would be my regular $110 plus this extra $110? So, $220?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's exactly right. Your next two bills would be approximately $220, plus any applicable taxes and fees. After those two payments, your account would be fully caught up, and your bill would return to the normal $110.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And the month after that too? Two months of $220?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. Two consecutive months. Does that sound like something that would work for you?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I think so. It's still a lot, but I can definitely manage that. It's much better than paying the whole thing at once.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. I'm glad we found a solution that helps.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Will... will this affect my account standing or my credit or anything like that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not at all. As long as you meet the payments under this new arrangement, your account will remain in good standing. It's treated as a formal agreement with us, so it prevents any negative reporting or service interruptions.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that's perfect. Yes, let's please set that up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. To formalize this, I need to read you a quick disclosure and then process it in our system. Are you ready?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I'm ready.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. By agreeing to this payment arrangement, you, Kimberly Smith, acknowledge a past due balance of $220. You agree to pay this balance in two installments of $110 each, which will be added to your next two regular monthly invoices from Cymbal Telecom. Failure to make these payments on time may void the arrangement and make the full balance due immediately. Do you agree to these terms?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I agree.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Now, I just need to apply this to your account. It can take a minute or two for the system to process. Do you mind holding for about 90 seconds while I get this finalized for you?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that's fine. Take your time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I'll be right back.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Ms. Smith? Thank you so much for your patience.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I'm here.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. I have successfully set up the payment arrangement on your account. I have a confirmation number for you as well, for your records. Would you like it?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, yes please. Let me grab a pen.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The confirmation number is PA, as in Payment Arrangement, 7-5-3-9-1.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, PA-75391. Got it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. You will also receive an email confirmation of this new arrangement within the hour, sent to the address we have on file, kimberly.smith@telecom-personal.com. Is that still correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's my email. That's great, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So just to recap one more time for clarity: The $10 late fee has been waived. Your past due balance of $220 is now scheduled to be paid in two installments of $110 on your next two bills. Your account is now current and protected from interruption.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That is such a huge weight off my shoulders. David, you've been incredibly helpful. Thank you so much.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's my pleasure, Ms. Smith. We're here to help our customers, especially when unexpected things come up. I'm glad we could work this out for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Me too. I really appreciate your understanding.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. While I have you on the line, is there anything else I can assist you with today? Any questions about your TV service, your internet speed, or anything at all?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, I don't think so. This was my only concern. Everything else has been working fine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's great to hear. I did just want to mention, I see you're paying your bill manually each month. Would you be interested in setting up automatic payments? It can help avoid situations like this in the future and ensures you're never late.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I've thought about it, but I'm a little hesitant. I like to see the bill before it gets paid.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand that. Just so you know, with our system, we still send you the bill notification about ten days before the payment is automatically drafted, so you always have time to review it. And some of our plans even offer a small monthly discount for enrolling.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, a discount? How much?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: For your Triple Play bundle, it would be a $5 discount per month if you enroll in both autopay and paperless billing.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hmm. Five dollars a month... you know, let me think about that. I think I have enough going on today. But I'll definitely consider it for next time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's perfectly fine. It's always an option in your online Cymbal account portal if you change your mind.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, good to know. Thank you for the information.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are most welcome. Is there anything else at all for today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that's everything. You've solved my problem completely.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. Well, thank you for being a valued Cymbal Telecom customer, Ms. Smith. We appreciate your business.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you, David. Have a good day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You too. Goodbye.
